### Current Behavior

使用attu连接，向量查询，查询出来是score是0.3600178360939026，但用pymilvus(2.3.0) 客户端连接，distance出现负数-0.3600178360939026
![image](https://github.com/milvus-io/milvus/assets/13518481/73e2609e-a3ee-4fa5-b7f1-9073cc19689c)

is this a by design change?
/unassign

this might be a client issue.

@shanghaikid @XuanYang-cn please check which SDK is wrong

> this might be a client issue.

> @shanghaikid @XuanYang-cn please check which SDK is wrong

I've checked node SDK's code, node SDK doesn't process the score value.

/assign @liliu-z 
please help to take a look as well

Here is my collection and index info,  cosine or ip will get negative distance. 
![image](https://github.com/milvus-io/milvus/assets/185051/49568770-86b6-4e07-97f8-d5c19ef105b1)
![image](https://github.com/milvus-io/milvus/assets/185051/a5b59dce-4854-486b-b4f6-ccaac8e9658b)

Getting a somewhat similar issue, with score being high integer 12004881368430412000. 
reproducible both with pymilvus and attu.
metric COSINE
index type IVF_FLAT 512 dimms
attu 2.3.0, 
milvus 2.3.5 cluster


![image](https://github.com/milvus-io/milvus/assets/46363/157aa071-67ba-49a2-a95e-3d8cfcf0158b)

@meako689 
do you have the query vector and the vector for that entity?

seems that those are very small values and there is no reason to overflow or what. 

any guess? @liliu-z @shanghaikid

To follow up on my issue, rebuilding the index did resolve the problem. 
Possible culprit was lack of disk storage on kafka and or nodes.

issue.body:
issue: https://github.com/milvus-io/milvus/issues/32262

The old implementation always takes metric type from the first sub result, which may not always be valid. The fixed implementation returns initialized metric type from sub results.
